title: Wakes in Pensacola and the shirt-turning characters
summary: Stories of the band attending a wake in Pensacola with Jimmy Johnson buying booze, and of Billy Douglas and Dink Taylor turning shirts inside out.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Well, listen, I want to ask you about guys in your band, but you don't have to mention who they did in what? Like going to Wakes, if you don't want to mention their names?

Well, that wasn't a matter about the names. Yeah, okay. Old Jimmy Johnson used to like to hit the bottle after we finished playing. And we were over in Pensacola. Some fella died, so the booker or somebody told us to be sure and go to where the Wakes was that happens was going to be there. So we all paid respect to the dead man. None of us knew who he was. Right in the back of the house where the man was laid out was where the happenings was and Jimmy Johnson was back there buying up the booze as fast as we could drink it. The only one that didn't drink that went there with us. I don't ever remember him drinking anything and the thing was Lloyd Glenn. But you said mention the names. All of us was there. We paid respect to the dead man.
And you just, it was like publicity?
No, it just went on. It was just there. Yeah, the book invited us to go and see the dead man.
Yeah, I see. Now did anybody, when they had a dirty shirt, would anybody ever do a thing with wearing the shirts inside and out?

Yes. Billy Douglas and Dink Taylor, man. They would turn that shirt around. Now those two, they were characters. I found this so funny. Yeah, my wife possibly told you that. Oh yes, she did. Sure she did.
